notes: All 48 candidate stops are treated as available destination nodes. This is a Dijkstra re-search upper bound, not a feasible stop program.

Formal counterfactual for a citywide steep-edge program: every edge with grade_abs_percent > 30 is recalculated with a 15 percent grade cap and Dijkstra is re-run. Budget, constructability, and exact path geometries are not validated here.
This is a weather-component upper bound: it removes weather terms citywide and re-runs Dijkstra. It is not evidence that local shelters or snow operations will produce the same effect.
